title: Jubilant Earthy Peruvian Beans Tacu Tacu
description: A hearty and earthy Peruvian dish featuring pecorino cheese and whole30-friendly ingredients, served in a tacu tacu form
instructions: Rinse the black beans and shock them in an ice bath to stop the cooking process
In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat and saute the diced red onion until translucent
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute
Stir in the crumbled pecorino cheese and cook until melted and well combined
Add the black beans, chopped cilantro, lime juice, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine
Using a spatula, shape the mixture into a tacu tacu form and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes on each side
Serve the tacu tacu hot and enjoy
Garnish with additional chopped cilantro if desired
